en: Gahh!!
Hey, you!!
Ugh...

jp: この傷じゃ、助からない・・・
en: Damn it! He won't survive a wound like that...
Kahh! Koff, koff!
You damned angel!!

jp: こいつは何もしてない！
ただの子供じゃないか！！
en: He didn't do anything! He's just a kid!!

jp: 何も殺す必要はないだろう！！？
en: There's no... There's no need to kill him!!?

jp: おやおや、本当にお気に入り
それならば失礼しました
en: Oh my, was he truly such a favorite of yours? Then do forgive me.

jp: 悪魔に接触した少年を殺すなら
en: Heh heh heh, yes, quite right. If I kill a boy for having contact with a demon,

jp: 悪魔にさらわれたあの少女も
粛正すべきでしょうか？
en: then that girl the demon abducted ought to be purged as well, should she not?

jp: 悪魔の手に触れられたモノ
en: All that a demon's hand has touched is unclean.

jp: 私が浄化してあげましょう
en: I shall purify it myself.

jp: ふふふ、ゾクゾクしますね
どんな殺し方にしましょうか？
en: Heh heh heh, it sends shivers down my spine. How shall I kill them, I wonder?

jp: あんたが何人殺そうと
en: I don't care how many you kill, but that sophistry of yours grates on my ears.

jp: そぎ取ってあげましょう
en: Is that so... Then I shall carve them off those ears for you.

jp: ふふふ、安心して下さい
すぐには殺しませんから
en: Heh heh heh, don't worry. I won't kill you right away.

jp: 聞かせてもらいますよ
en: You will be telling me all sorts of things first.

jp: アタシはまだ死ねない！！
en: Kh... I can't die yet! Not in a place like this!!
Ma... tia... ...won't let you...
You half-dead wretch! Stay out of my way!!
Luca!!

jp: 仲間がいたとは・・・
en: Kh! So there was a companion...
Luca!! Now's our chance, let's go!!
Luca!! Hurry!!
I know! I know, but!!
That kid is...!!
Damn!! I won't let you escape!!

jp: 俺たちの目的を忘れたのか！！
en: Luca!! Have you forgotten our purpose!!
......Kh. Fine.
Enough!! Damn it, damn it!! Let go of me already!!!
......Kh! They got away.
Grisina-sama!!

jp: どうなされたのですか？
それに、この子供は・・・
en: What happened? And this child...
A heretic. I dealt with him.

jp: まだ、子供じゃないですか？
微かに息もありますが・・・
en: But isn't he still a child? And he's faintly breathing...

jp: 異端者に大人も子供もありません
en: Among heretics there are neither adults nor children.

jp: ふふふ、死に向かう痛みは
さぞかし恐ろしいものでしょうね
en: Heh heh heh, the pain of dying must be truly terrifying.
..Ma... tia..

jp: ここで止めをさしてあげるのが
慈悲でしょうが、生きて、生きて
苦しみながら死になさい
en: Finishing you here would be the merciful thing, but no. Live, live, and die in agony.

jp: 死の帳が貴方を優しく包むまで
痛みと孤独に耐え抜くことが
貴方の浄罪への道ですよ
en: Endure pain and solitude till death's veil enfolds you. That is your road to penance.
I beseech thee...

jp: 無知ゆえに過ちを犯した幼き魂に
救いの光を射し与えたまえ・・・
en: O Earth Mother, cast thy saving light upon this young soul that erred in ignorance...

jp: もう死んでしまったようですね
en: Oh? It seems he's already dead.

jp: 異端者に墓はいりません
死体は捨ててしまいなさい
en: Heretics need no graves. Throw the body away.
...Sir.
Young man
Bonjour
Cain
